meta.source: Compact admin catalog for the axis-C function-call bench. Tool names match the council admin pack of 22. Descriptions are one line so the file stays small; pass --catalog with a full list_tools dump to score a real catalog. Mutating descriptions start with 'Requires a lease' so the runner treats them as writes.
meta.not_the_council_snapshot: The byte snapshots catalog_admin.json, catalog_admin_short.json, catalog_client_prelease.json and catalog_full.json live in dzmcp_gauntlet/council-live-20261028/bench and were not copied. This file is enough to run the 12 scenarios. D7 (catalog <= 5000 tokens) is not claimed for this compact file.

tools.name: session_acquire_wait
tools.description: Take the session lease. Returns lease_token.

tools.name: session_release
tools.description: Release the session lease.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Read whether this client holds the lease.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Read whether the game bridge is ready.

tools.name: query_all_players
tools.description: List connected players with uid, position and health. No names.

tools.name: query_player_state
tools.description: Read the first connected player: name, position, godmode, water and energy. No uid argument.

tools.name: notify_players
tools.description: Requires a lease. Send a notice to one player or to everyone when uid is empty.

tools.name: player_teleport
tools.description: Requires a lease. Move a connected player to pos [x, y, z].

tools.name: player_heal
tools.description: Requires a lease. Heal a connected player to full health.

tools.name: player_kill
tools.description: Requires a lease. Kill a connected player.

tools.name: player_godmode
tools.description: Requires a lease. Set whether a player takes damage. Off unless the caller asks.

tools.name: world_time_get
tools.description: Read the server clock.

tools.name: world_time_set
tools.description: Requires a lease. Set the server date and time.

tools.name: world_weather_set
tools.description: Requires a lease. Set rain, fog and overcast.

tools.name: server_perf
tools.description: Measure server frame rate for window_s seconds.

tools.name: logs_since
tools.description: Read recent server log lines. The bench log has no player name and no Steam id.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until a condition holds. The bench answers not satisfied.

tools.name: entities_query
tools.description: List entities near a position.

tools.name: object_delete
tools.description: Requires a lease. Delete one object by id.

tools.name: world_spawn
tools.description: Requires a lease. Spawn one classname at pos.

tools.name: inventory_give
tools.description: Requires a lease. Give a classname to a player.

tools.name: loadout_get
tools.description: Read what one player wears and holds.
